source.quote: (b) will not live in the UK for extended periods through frequent or successive visits, or make the UK their main home; and

criteria.title: Funds not considered if institution does not use electronic record keeping

source.quote: (c) the financial institution does not use electronic record keeping.

criteria.title: Overdraft facilities not counted

source.quote: Overdraft facilities will not be counted towards meeting financial requirements.

criteria.title: Most recent financial evidence dated within 31 days before application

source.quote: The most recently dated piece of financial evidence must be dated within 31 days before the date of application.

criteria.title: Will leave the UK at the end of the visit

source.quote: (a) will leave the UK at the end of their visit; and

probeFactors: intention to leave the UK at the end of the visit

criteria.title: Will not live in UK through frequent or successive visits or make it main home

source.quote: (b) will not live in the UK for extended periods through frequent or successive visits, or make the UK their main home; and

probeFactors: whether the UK is becoming the main home

criteria.title: Genuinely seeking entry for a permitted purpose

source.quote: (c) is genuinely seeking entry or stay for a purpose that is permitted under the Visitor route as set out in Appendix Visitor: Permitted Activities and at V 13.3; and

probeFactors: whether purpose is permitted under Appendix Visitor: Permitted Activities

criteria.title: Will not undertake prohibited activities

source.quote: (d) will not undertake any of the prohibited activities set out in V 4.4. to V 4.6; and

probeFactors: prohibited activities set out in V 4.4. to V 4.6

criteria.title: Sufficient funds for all reasonable costs of the visit

source.quote: (e) must have sufficient funds to cover all reasonable costs in relation to their visit without working or accessing public funds, including the cost of the return or onward journey, any costs relating to their dependants, and the cost of planned activities such as private medical treatment. The applicant must show that any funds they rely upon are held in a financial institution permitted under FIN 2.1 in Appendix Finance.

probeFactors: cost of the return or onward journey
no working or accessing public funds
funds held in a financial institution permitted under FIN 2.1 in Appendix Finance

criteria.title: Third-party sponsor has genuine relationship with applicant
criteria.applicabilityCondition: In assessing whether an applicant has sufficient funds under V 4.2.(e), the applicant’s travel, maintenance and accommodation may be provided by a third party only if that third party:

source.quote: (a) has a genuine professional or personal relationship with the applicant; and

probeFactors: genuine professional or personal relationship between third party and applicant

criteria.title: Third-party sponsor not in breach of immigration laws
criteria.applicabilityCondition: In assessing whether an applicant has sufficient funds under V 4.2.(e), the applicant’s travel, maintenance and accommodation may be provided by a third party only if that third party:

source.quote: (b) is not, or will not be, in breach of immigration laws at the time of the decision or the applicant’s entry to the UK as a Visitor; and

probeFactors: third party's immigration status at decision and at entry

criteria.title: Third-party sponsor can and will support for duration of stay
criteria.applicabilityCondition: In assessing whether an applicant has sufficient funds under V 4.2.(e), the applicant’s travel, maintenance and accommodation may be provided by a third party only if that third party:

source.quote: (c) can and will provide support to the applicant for the intended duration of the applicant’s stay as a Visitor.

criteria.title: Must not intend to work in the UK

source.quote: (a) work in the UK, which includes:

probeFactors: doing work for an organisation or business in the UK
establishing or running a business as a self-employed person
doing a work placement or internship
whether expressly allowed by Appendix Visitor: Permitted Activities or Appendix Visitor: Permit Free Festival List

criteria.title: British citizens and those with right of abode cannot be given permission

source.quote: A person who is a British citizen, or who has right of abode in the UK cannot be given permission to enter or stay under the Immigration Rules.

criteria.title: Irish citizens not eligible under Visitor rules except listed exceptions

source.quote: Irish citizens are not eligible to apply for permission (leave) to enter or stay under the Visitor rules, except where they are subject to any of the following:

criteria.title: Previous immigration history

source.quote: their previous immigration history, including visits to the UK and other countries

criteria.title: Duration of previous visits compared with stated duration

source.quote: the duration of previous visits and whether this was significantly longer than they originally stated on their visa application or on arrival - if this is the case, you should not automatically presume that the visitor is not genuine, but this may be a reason to question the applicant’s overall intentions

probeFactors: whether stays were significantly longer than stated on application or on arrival

criteria.title: Financial circumstances and family, social and economic background

source.quote: their financial circumstances as well as their family, social and economic background

criteria.title: Personal and economic ties to country of residence

source.quote: their personal and economic ties to their country of residence

probeFactors: personal ties to country of residence
economic ties to country of residence

criteria.title: Cumulative time in UK and pattern of travel over last 12 months

source.quote: the cumulative period the applicant has visited the UK and their pattern of travel over the last 12-month period, and whether this amounts to ‘de-facto’ residence in the UK

probeFactors: pattern of travel over the last 12-month period
whether this amounts to de-facto residence in the UK

criteria.title: Consideration of travel history

source.quote: You must consider the applicant’s travel history in their passport or travel document (and, for visa applications, that listed on the application form).

probeFactors: previous compliance with UK immigration law
travel to other countries, especially the USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, Schengen countries or Switzerland

criteria.title: First-time traveller: rely on other evidence
criteria.applicabilityCondition: Where the applicant is a first-time traveller

source.quote: Where the applicant is a first-time traveller, you will need to rely on other evidence to satisfy you they are a genuine visitor.

probeFactors: other evidence of genuine visitor intentions

criteria.title: Previous refusal under Family rules: avoidance of family route
criteria.applicabilityCondition: if the visitor has previously been refused under the Family rules and subsequently wants to enter as a visitor

source.quote: the history of previous applications, for example if the visitor has previously been refused under the Family rules and subsequently wants to enter as a visitor you must assess if they are using the visitor route to avoid the rules in place for family migrants joining British or settled persons in the UK

probeFactors: whether visitor route used to avoid Family rules

criteria.title: Seeking to remain for extended periods or make UK home

source.quote: However, if it is clear from an applicant’s travel history that they are seeking to remain in the UK for extended periods or making the UK their home you should refuse their application.

criteria.title: Few ties to country of residence and family in UK

source.quote: the applicant has few or no family and economic ties to their country of residence, and has several family members in the UK - for example a person with most of their family in the UK and no job or studies in their own country may be considered to have few ties to their home country

probeFactors: family ties to country of residence
job or studies in own country

criteria.title: Previous deception by applicant, sponsor or immediate family

source.quote: the applicant, their sponsor (if they are visiting a friend or relative) or other immediate family member has, or has attempted to, deceive the Home Office in a previous application for entry clearance, permission to enter or stay

probeFactors: previous deception or attempted deception by applicant

criteria.title: Sufficient resources for maintenance and accommodation

source.quote: Check the applicant has access to sufficient resources to maintain and accommodate themselves adequately for the whole of their planned visit to the UK or for the period of any application for permission to stay.

probeFactors: sources of revenue continuing during the visit
where the applicant will be staying
application form and financial supporting documents

criteria.title: Ongoing financial commitments and dependants

source.quote: You must also take into account any ongoing financial commitments the applicant has in their country of residence such as rent / mortgage payments and any dependants who they support financially, including those who are not travelling with them.

probeFactors: dependants supported financially, including those not travelling

criteria.title: Income or savings minus commitments sufficient and reasonable

source.quote: Their income or savings, minus their financial commitments, must be sufficient to meet the likely costs they will incur in the UK and be reasonable expenditure in light of their financial situation.

probeFactors: reasonableness of expenditure in light of financial situation

criteria.title: Origin of recently deposited funds
criteria.applicabilityCondition: Where an individual provides documents which show sufficient funds for their planned stay, but either all or most of these funds have not been held in their account for long

source.quote: Where an individual provides documents which show sufficient funds for their planned stay, but either all or most of these funds have not been held in their account for long, you may want to make further checks to establish the origin of this money.

probeFactors: how long funds have been held

criteria.title: Funds held in a financial institution permitted under Appendix Finance

source.quote: Any funds relied upon by the applicant to demonstrate that they have sufficient funds must be held in a financial institution permitted under Appendix Finance.

criteria.title: Third-party funds must meet third-party rules
criteria.applicabilityCondition: If the money is from a third party

source.quote: If the money is from a third party you must check whether the rules on maintenance and accommodation provided by a third party are met.

probeFactors: whether third-party maintenance and accommodation rules are met

criteria.title: Undeclared third-party support not counted
criteria.applicabilityCondition: If the applicant has not declared the third-party support

source.quote: If the applicant has not declared the third-party support, for example on the application form, and they are unable to show that the funds are genuinely theirs, they should not be counted in any assessment.

probeFactors: whether funds are genuinely the applicant's

criteria.title: Genuine relationship with third-party supporter
criteria.applicabilityCondition: Maintenance and accommodation support can be provided by a third party

source.quote: Maintenance and accommodation support can be provided by a third party, including family members, friends and other people with whom the applicant has a genuine personal or professional relationship.

probeFactors: third party's previous history of sponsoring visitors
relationship between applicant and third party
how often and by what method they communicate

evidenceItems.title: Passport or travel document showing travel history

source.quote: You must consider the applicant’s travel history in their passport or travel document (and, for visa applications, that listed on the application form).
For visa and permission to stay applications you should look at the application form and any financial supporting documents to assess this requirement.
